ILMN.note: Dominant short-read installed base; NovaSeq X drives razor/razorblade consumable pull-through — the picks-and-shovels anchor

PACB.note: Long-read pure-play (Revio); real tech differentiation but micro-cap, cash-burning — optionality within the platform bucket

TXG.note: Single-cell/spatial consumables franchise; recurring reagent pull-through but IP-litigation and growth overhang

TWST.note: Silicon DNA-synthesis platform — hard-to-substitute upstream input for synbio + NGS panels; still pre-profit

QGEN.note: Sample-to-insight consumables + QuantiFERON; sponsored NYSE ADR, real FCF, defensive consumables

A.note: Diversified analytical + genomics tools; durable FCF, diluted theme purity — quality ballast

TMO.note: Sells reagents/instruments to every genomics lab; real revenue + margins, diffuse but safe exposure

EXAS.note: Reimbursed screening scale (Cologuard) + Oncodetect MRD; the flagship real-revenue molecular-dx franchise

GH.note: Guardant360 + Shield blood screening; liquid-biopsy volume compounding, reimbursement is the swing factor

NTRA.note: Signatera MRD compounding ~40% YoY on a large proprietary dataset; category-leading tumor-informed MRD

VCYT.note: Reimbursed genomic-classifier franchise (Decipher, Afirma); profitable, narrower TAM than GH/NTRA

CRSP.note: Best-capitalized editor; Casgevy approved/commercial + large cash runway — the core of the optionality sleeve

NTLA.note: In-vivo editing leader (NTLA-2001/2002) but clinical-stage, dilutive; binary catalyst risk

BEAM.note: Base-editing platform differentiation; pre-revenue, cash-burning — small optionality only

MRNA.note: mRNA platform + INT personalized cancer vaccine w/ Merck; large cash pile but revenue cliff post-COVID

BNTX.note: mRNA individualized cancer immunotherapy pipeline; strong balance sheet, sponsored NASDAQ ADR
